**New: Remount SD card**
- The in-game menu (Select+Start or Back) has a new "Remount SD card" option. It takes the emulated card out and puts it back about a second and a half later, so Palm OS reads it again, just like re-seating the card on a real Zodiac.
- Use it if the launcher stops showing the card, or a game can't find its files.

Includes everything from v0.5 (the ARM recompiler).
